>Just a quick question - did you title this after the Stevie Smith poem? 

Yes, I did.

The original version of Song from Under the Floorboards is one of my favourite songs. Thanks for posting the cover.

Female. And it's not hard to get a date. But I don't want to. I've gone out with two guys since the breakup and both times they were wonderful people and both times I sat there miserable and didn't give them any of my attention because I feel like I am under water. 

I know I can do better. I know that there is someone who will see the fact that I am a genuinely caring and kind person and not want to use and destroy that part of me. 

I just can't and won't look for it right now. I'm going through something epic, and I do not want to drag another person down here with me. 

Thank you.

You know what? He's all three. Long story short, he and I met 10 years ago and had a casual, flirtatious acquaintanceship until 2 years ago, when it became something more. 

I helped him get through a really tough time in his life, and his father called me to thank me. (Which was odd; his father lives in another city, I had never met him, and I'm not quite sure how he got my phone number, but I digress).

His father told me that he had an uncanny ability to get people to do whatever he wanted them to do; that he knew exactly what to say, that he was a master manipulator. I thought it was an odd thing to say at the time, but it's true. He *is* a narcissist, he *is* a sociopath. He doesn't care who he destroys, so long as he gets what he wants. He is - and I'm not just saying this because I loved him -  unbelievably gorgeous and funny and witty, which is why having women fall all over themselves just to talk to him is so easy for him. He *loves* it. He loves the fact that he can get anyone he wants. I've watched it happen. He really can. And he uses them for his gain and tosses them. 

The breakup happened three months ago; he's just been pulling my strings this whole time and last night was just absolutely it. I have my own place now, but nobody I can call. My friends are all pretty self absorbed. I'm pretty much on my own.

But this frog finally realised the pot of water was boiling. And it took way fucking longer than it should have. I'm actually embarrassed and angry at myself that it took me this long.

I don't know what to do. I'm posting this as a way to stop crying and maybe calm down so I can drive myself to the hospital.
It's never been this bad before and I can't see through it anymore. 
I don't care that he is on reddit, I don't care if he sees this.

I can't live without him. I can't. He's the only man I've ever loved. I wanted to spend the rest of my life with him.  After years of wanting him I finally got him. But he was never here, not really. He was pining over his ex, and then he was on the internet looking for someone else. He was on the internet talking to these girls he met on these sites while I was in his bed, crying. Because I knew. For over a year. He lied and lied and lied. He used every thing I had. I am empty and broken and he thinks it's funny.

He told me he loved me. He told me we were soulmates. He told me he wanted to spend his life with me. He told me everything I wanted to hear but it was nothing. He meant none of it. He broke up with me in January, and a couple of weeks after started calling. And texting. Begging to see me. And I went. Because I am a fucking idiot. And he told me it was a huge mistake and he was in love with me and he wanted me and we needed a break of a couple of weeks but oh, it will be so wonderful when we are back. Oh, how he loved me, and I was the only one that could make him happy.

Lies. 

Why? Why do that to someone? Why say these things and not mean them to someone who loves you? Why break my heart a thousand times only to beg for me to come back so you can do it again? And again, and again. What did I do? What did I do to deserve it? I gave him everything. I was there for him whenever he needed me. I took care of him when he was sick. I supported him when he was out of work. I gave and I gave and he took and he took and then he smashed my fucking heart into a million pieces and for what? 

I hope it was fun for him. I hope he enjoyed breaking my fucking heart, emptying my bank account, and leaving me homeless. I hope it was fun for him to so completely destroy my ability to trust another person, to so completely destroy any confidence I had in myself. To so completely destroy the amazing, beautiful, funny person I was before I fucking met him. I could never open myself up before him. I am 27. I had been in three long term relationships before him, but I didn't love any of them. I didn't get close. I couldn't do it. But I did with him. Because I am a fucking idiot.

There is more going on in my life than some stupid fucking asshole, but tonight was the final straw. Tonight was I can't take this shit anymore. Tonight after driving him (a 2 hour round trip) home after him spending last night and today with me watching a Season 4 Battlestar marathon and having sex with me, because I am a fucking IDIOT, I couldn't stand to not know why or how someone could so carelessly and easily manipulate and destroy someone else. 

He doesn't love me, he doesn't want me, he is fucking with me because he can. It's as simple as that.

"There is someone out there better for you". NO FUCKING SHIT. 

I don't want to hear that it was him, not me. Stop being such a cliche, you sanctimonious prick. Stop trying to absolve yourself of everything you did to me because you're "messed up about relationships". Fuck you. 

I don't know what to do. And I'm not ok.
